author: ZiZc3
description:
LiveShell Wallpapers
	

Video files for the Discover tab of LiveShell Engine, the animated
wallpaper mod for the PS5 home screen. Browse and download them on the PS5 in Discover; this repository only
stores the files.
Every file is checked before it is added: H.264 / HEVC, 8-bit, 16:9, up to 4K, complete.
Anything reported for copyright is removed.
